backup.restore_point: PENDING - name the backup set taken immediately before this apply
backup.production_rule: The Cascade Staff sign-in screen groups names into Staff and Admin. One new anon-callable function staff_signin_list_v2() returns (label, handle, kind, team): exactly staff_signin_list_v1 plus team, 'admin' for the roles owner, admin and finance, 'staff' for every other role. v1 is untouched. No table, column, policy or data change. Re-running the migration is harmless (create or replace). restore_point is a placeholder: the release block fills it (fill-restore-point.mjs).
backup.notes: Deploy order: SQL first, then the Staff app (it falls back to v1 while v2 is missing). No new secret.

forward_verification.name: v2_exists_with_the_team_column
forward_verification.query: select pg_get_function_result('public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure) = 'TABLE(label text, handle text, kind text, team text)'

forward_verification.name: v2_definer_with_an_empty_search_path
forward_verification.query: select prosecdef and proconfig @> array['search_path=""'] from pg_proc where oid = 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure

forward_verification.name: anon_and_authenticated_can_execute_and_public_cannot
forward_verification.query: select has_function_privilege('anon', 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()', 'execute') and has_function_privilege('authenticated', 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()', 'execute') and not exists (select 1 from pg_proc p, aclexplode(p.proacl) a where p.oid = 'public.staff_signin_list_v2()'::regprocedure and a.grantee = 0)

forward_verification.name: one_row_per_active_profile
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from public.staff_signin_list_v2()) = (select count(*) from public.staff_signin_list_v1()) and (select count(*) from public.staff_signin_list_v2()) = (select count(*) from public.staff_access_profiles p join auth.users u on u.id = p.user_id where p.disabled_at is null and u.deleted_at is null and (u.banned_until is null or u.banned_until <= now()) and u.email is not null and u.email <> '')

forward_verification.name: team_is_only_staff_or_admin
forward_verification.query: select coalesce(bool_and(team in ('staff', 'admin')), true) from public.staff_signin_list_v2()

forward_verification.name: every_cleaner_row_is_staff
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.staff_signin_list_v2() v join auth.users u on lower(u.email) = v.handle join public.staff_access_profiles p on p.user_id = u.id where p.role = 'cleaner' and v.team <> 'staff')

forward_verification.name: no_owner_admin_or_finance_row_is_staff
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from public.staff_signin_list_v2() v join auth.users u on lower(u.email) = v.handle join public.staff_access_profiles p on p.user_id = u.id where p.role in ('owner', 'admin', 'finance') and v.team = 'staff')

rollback.safe_until: always, once the Staff app no longer calls v2. The rollback drops staff_signin_list_v2 and nothing else; v1 was never touched.

feature_flags.name: no_flag_the_app_falls_back_to_v1
feature_flags.required_state: None. The sign-in screen groups by team when v2 answers and shows the flat v1 list when it does not.

compatibility.evidence: One new function; staff_signin_list_v1 is unchanged, so the current sign-in screen keeps working. No table, column or grant on an existing object changes.

stop_conditions: any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
